save-failed: Error when a cost pool, reading, price or sync request could not be saved.
categories.hardware: Each categories.*: the category of a cost pool (an admin's running cost of a self-hosted backend or subscription), in a badge and a select.
periods.hour: Each periods.*: an option of the cost pool form's Per select (the amount is per hour, day, month or year). Lowercase.
sources.admin: Each sources.*: where a model price came from, in the Prices table's Source column and the price sync table. "Admin": an admin entered it. The others are names of public price lists; keep product names (OpenRouter, DeepInfra, Azure, AWS, Bedrock, models.dev, LiteLLM) as they are.
actions: Hidden column heading for screen readers, over a table's row buttons.
remove: Button in a table row: removes that cost pool, reading or price.
pools.description: "Turns": answers from a socio (an AI agent). "Idle capacity": cost in hours without turns.
pools.took: Column heading: the part of a pool's cost the turns used.
pools.idle: Column heading: the part of a pool's cost in hours without turns.
pools.estimate: Badge on a subscription pool: its cost per turn is an estimate.
pools.gpu: Badge on a pool shared by GPU time, which nothing measures yet.
pools.no-backends: In a pool's row, when it pays for no backend; lowercase.
pools.terms.variable: What a metered pool costs: {{amount}} is US dollars per unit (a kWh, for one).
pools.terms.depreciated: What a purchase costs: {{amount}} in US dollars, written off over a number of months.
pools.terms.per: What a running cost pool costs: {{amount}} in US dollars per hour, day, month or year.
pools.readings: Button: shows a metered pool's meter readings.
pools.removed: Toast after a cost pool was removed.
pools.add: Button: opens the form for a new cost pool.
pool-form.change: Heading of the form that changes a cost pool; {{name}} is its name.
pool-form.metered: Checkbox label: the pool's cost comes from meter readings.
pool-form.amount: Label of the amount field, by kind of pool: running cost, metered (per unit) or purchase.
pool-form.per: Label of the select of the period the amount is for.
pool-form.months: Label: over how many months a purchase is written off.
pool-form.backends: Heading of the checkboxes of backends (where models run) the pool pays for.
pool-form.no-backends: "Platform": another page of Operations' admin settings.
pool-form.weights: Heading of the fields that say how much each kind of token counts when an hour's cost is shared among turns.
pool-form.saved: Toast after a cost pool was changed.
pool-form.added: Toast after a cost pool was added.
readings.title: Heading; {{name}} is the cost pool's name.
readings.reading: One meter reading: {{quantity}} used, {{unit}} as the admin typed it (kWh), {{price}} in US dollars per unit.
readings.removed: Toast after a meter reading was removed.
readings.added: Toast after a meter reading was added.
readings.read-on: Label of the date field of a new meter reading.
readings.used: Label of the quantity field of a new meter reading.
sync.on: Card description while the daily price sync is on; a link to Settings follows. "Socio" is the product's name.
sync.off: Card description while the daily price sync is off; a link to Settings follows.
sync.switch: Link to Operations → Settings, where the price sync is switched on or off.
sync.list: Column heading: a public price list.
sync.kept: Column heading: how many of the list's models Socio kept the prices of.
sync.failed: Badge when the last read of a price list failed; {{error}} is the error text, not translated.
sync.never: In the Last read column for a list never read.
sync.matched: How many models were kept ({{matched}}) of those the list had ({{fetched}}).
sync.next: When the next sync runs; {{when}} is a date and time.
prices.description: "Provider *": the asterisk is typed as the provider to mean any provider; keep it.
prices.cached: Column heading: the price of cached input tokens.
prices.from: Column heading: the date a price holds from.
prices.source: Column heading: where the price came from (sources.*).
prices.removed: Toast after an admin's price was removed.
price-form.provider: Label: the provider's id; typing * means any provider.
price-form.saved: Toast after a price was saved.
